observations: Photo 0: Black original-shape PS4 console (thicker body typical of first-generation PS4) sitting on a patterned rug, with a camouflage-patterned DualShock 4 controller in front.
Photo 1: Same black PS4 console, closer view showing 'SONY' and 'PS4' markings on the front, but the controller shown here is plain black, not camouflage.
No model/serial plate, HDD label, or box visible in either photo.
Watermark 'THE GAME GUY VENTURES' overlaid on photo 1, suggesting a reseller's stock photo rather than the actual unit for sale.
No photo of the console powered on, no screen showing a game library, no photo of ports or rear panel.

identity.kind: PS4 console (original/fat model) with one DualShock 4 controller
read_from: photo 1 console front (SONY, PS4 text visible)

claims.evidence: No region sticker, box, or documentation shown in either photo.
Photo 0 shows a camouflage-patterned controller; photo 1 shows a different plain black controller, implying either two pads exist or a stock photo was reused.

claims.claim: 10 pre-installed games including fifa 27, pes 27, gta
claims.evidence: No screenshot of the PS4 home screen or game library is shown. Also, 'FIFA 27' and 'PES 27' are not real released titles as of now, which raises doubt about the accuracy of the listing text.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault (common with used PS4 units, e.g. HDD failure, overheating, blinking blue light).
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on to the PS4 home screen.

risks.risk: Mismatched controller in the two photos suggests the actual pad included is unclear, and may not be the pictured camo one.
risks.proof: A single clear photo of the exact pad being shipped, matching the console in the same shot.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single generic/worn controller, not the camo one

risks.risk: Claimed games may not exist or may not actually be installed (titles named do not match real released games).
risks.proof: Screenshot of the PS4 library/menu showing installed game icons and titles.
risks.if_unproven: priced as console only, no bundled games

risks.risk: Storage capacity and true console generation (standard vs non-existent, since 'original' vs 'slim' affects price) cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear/bottom label showing model number (e.g., CUH-10xx) and storage size.
risks.if_unproven: priced at base original-model capacity assumption

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear or hidden damage (scratches, dust, HDMI port condition) not fully visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of rear ports and any scuff/dent areas.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on to the PS4 home/dashboard screen.
Photo of the rear label showing exact model number and storage capacity.
Clear photo of the single controller being sold, in the same frame as the console.
Screenshot of the installed games list from the PS4 menu.
response.reason: The console itself is identifiable as a used PS4, but the mismatched controllers between photos and the listing of non-existent game titles ('FIFA 27', 'PES 27') make the bundle contents too uncertain to price even at a worst case without seeing the actual pad and a working power-on proof.
